projects.description: Primary research, multi-provider checkpoint validation, and publication pipeline.

projects.name: Global Clean-Energy Grid Optimization
projects.description: Document comparison, spreadsheet modeling, and executive keynote presentation.

projectMemories.title: Zero-Subscription & Free-First Mandate
projectMemories.content: Prioritize local Ollama models and free/BYOK APIs. Never invoke paid providers without explicit user opt-in.

projectMemories.title: Checkpoint Granularity Policy
projectMemories.content: Persist compact Continuation Packages after every pipeline stage (18%, 34%, 48%, 65%, 85%, 100%) so mid-task provider switches never restart completed work.

projectMemories.title: Last Month Research Finding — Context Compression
projectMemories.content: Last month's benchmark proved that structured Continuation Packages reduce cross-provider fallback token overhead by 78% compared to raw chat history replay.

knowledgeVault.title: August Benchmark: Multi-Provider Checkpoint Recovery
knowledgeVault.content: Detailed study from last month showing that when Provider A hits HTTP 429 at 65% completion, transferring a structured JSON Continuation Package allows Provider B (e.g., Groq or Local Ollama) to finish the remaining 35% with 0% loss of validated citations.

knowledgeVault.title: Prompt Injection Defense Specification (XML Envelope Isolation)
knowledgeVault.content: Separates <system_instructions>, <user_instructions>, <retrieved_content>, <web_content>, and <file_content> to neutralize adversarial override payloads inside untrusted PDFs and websites.

knowledgeVault.title: Clean-Energy Storage Cost Matrix (2025–2026)
knowledgeVault.content: Grid-scale LFP and sodium-ion battery storage telemetry comparing levelized cost of storage (LCOS) across regional microgrids.

## 1. Executive Summary
AVRENYX unifies local open-weight models (Ollama) and legitimate cloud/BYOK providers behind a capability-based Central AI Router, Smart Cost Guard, and Durable Checkpoint Continuation Engine.
